109 (((cmsg) == NULL) ? CMSG_FIRSTHDR(mhdr) : \
110 (((unsigned char *)(cmsg) + ROUND_UP((cmsg)->cmsg_len, sizeof(size_t)) + \
111 ROUND_UP(sizeof(struct cmsghdr), sizeof(size_t)) > \
112 (unsigned char *)((mhdr)->msg_control) + (mhdr)->msg_controllen) ? \
113 NULL : \
114 (struct cmsghdr *)((unsigned char *)(cmsg) + ROUND_UP((cmsg)->cmsg_len, sizeof(size_t)))))

118 (((mhdr)->msg_controllen >= sizeof(struct cmsghdr) ? \
119 (struct cmsghdr *)((mhdr)->msg_control) : NULL))
